# F3: Shell and harness

**Model:** Opus 5.5, high effort (Vali, 2026-11-12: high for F3 and every chat after it).
**Paste to start:** `Read CLAUDE.md, then docs/build/STATUS.md and docs/build/kickoffs/F3.md, and do F3. Stop for my review at the end.`

## Goal
Build the empty, working skeleton every scene chat plugs into: one scroll controller, one scene contract, placeholder scenes at the right heights, a deep-link to any frame, and a QA harness that compares screenshots with the F2 storyboard. Nothing in F3 is visual design; the placeholders are deliberately plain.

## Inputs (read only these)
- `docs/build/STATUS.md`: the contracts in force and every F2 decision (change log, 2026-11-12 entries). They override the spec.
- `PROTEST_VIZ_SPEC.md` **sections 3, 6 and 8 only**: architecture, the scroll model and budget, and the cross-cutting requirements. Section 7 only for each scene's `p` table when writing the scene briefs.
- `docs/build/BUILD_PLAN.md` sections 2 (Phase 0 F3, Phase 1 table, "the loop every scene chat follows", the brief template) and 4 (decisions D1–D13).
- `design/storyboard.js`: the frame list and each frame's `why` note, which is the visual target per scene. `design/shots/frames/ink-*.png` are the reference images.
- `design/lib/roach.js`, `design/lib/kit.js`: the verbatim `roach()` and the shared helpers to promote.
- `index.html` (v2, about lines 474–560): how anime.js v4.5 is imported (import map, CDN) and its `onScroll` plumbing. Reuse that pattern; don't edit the file.
- `tools/cdp-scroll.mjs`: the existing CDP scroll-and-screenshot tool to extend.

## Outputs
**Shell (D1: v3 lives in `v3/index.html`; promoted to `index.html` only at the end of the project):**
```
v3/index.html              import map (animejs 4.5 only; no D3 yet, per D10), tokens.css, <html data-theme="ink">
src/main.js                boot: load data, build scenes, start the controller
src/scroll/controller.js   the ONE scroll owner: scrollY → (scene, p)
src/scroll/budget.js       scene order and lengths in vh (single source of truth)
src/scenes/sNN-*.js        one placeholder module per scene (list below)
src/roach/roach.js         verbatim roach() moved from design/lib/roach.js (design/lib re-exports it)
src/roach/swarm.js         shared swarm state for the prologue (S0–S4), seeded RNG
src/lib/*                  rng, halftone, skeleton helpers, dates, esc/missing/showable (promoted from design/lib/kit.js; no behaviour change)
src/data/load.js           fetch + cache data/story/*.json and data/map/base.json
```
- **Scene list and order:** S0, S1, S2, S3, **S3.5 (new: the claim and the correction)**, S4, S5, S6, S6.5, S7 (A, B, C), S8 (one per selected quote), S9, S10.
- **Budget** (vh, start from the spec section 6 table; record changes in STATUS):
  - Prologue: S0 80, S1 150, S2 60 (+ timed sequence), S3 180, **S3.5 160**, S4 180.
  - S5 **810**: the spec's 880 minus the 70vh Victory node. Victory is not in the map stage; it lives only in S6.
  - S6 260, S6.5 auto, S7 3 × 170, S8 3 × 100, S9 100, S10 auto.
- **Scene contract** (spec section 3): `{ id, init(ctx), enter(dir), update(p), exit(dir), resize(w, h) }`. `update(p)` must be pure in `p`: the same `p` always draws the same picture, scrolling down or up (determinism rule).
- **Controller:**
  - Built on anime.js `onScroll` plus CSS sticky. There is exactly one controller; scenes never listen to scroll themselves.
  - Pinned stages: the prologue (S0–S4 on one fixed canvas stack), S5 and S6.
  - Exposes `seek(sceneId, p)` and `lock()` / `unlock()` for the S2 timed sequence (spec S2 rules).
- **Desktop gate:** below 1280×720, show a plain message instead of the piece. No mobile layout.
- **`?debug`:** a HUD in a screen corner showing the scene id, `p` to 3 decimals, scrollY and FPS. It must never cover content (keep it in a corner, small).
- **`?p=S4:0.6`:** a deep-link that scrolls to an exact frame on load. QA and design review depend on it.

**Harness:**
- Extend `tools/cdp-scroll.mjs` (keep its CLI working) so a target can be `"S4:0.6"` instead of a JS expression.
- Write one `docs/build/scenes/targets/SNN.json` per scene, listing that scene's key frames from the storyboard.
- Add `tools/compare.mjs`: puts each QA shot side by side with its storyboard frame (`design/shots/frames/ink-<frame>.png`) in a single PNG.
- QA always runs scrolling **down, then up**, and logs `p` at each target.

**Scene briefs**, `docs/build/scenes/SNN.md`, one per Phase 1 chat (S4a, S0, S1–S2, S3 + S3.5, S4b, S5a, S5b, S5c, S6, S6.5, S7, S8–S10, M9). Use BUILD_PLAN's brief template:
- Purpose.
- Allowed data keys.
- Files it owns.
- Files it must not touch.
- Contracts it consumes.
- Key frames (`p` → expected picture, citing the storyboard frame).
- Done-when list.
- Vali's notes.

Carry over every F2 decision:
- Ink theme.
- Public Sans Black date skeleton.
- Roaches joining from the edges during the S4 converge.
- Founder shrinks into the swarm in S3.
- Map roach size rule.
- Empty slots for the S4 caption, S6.5 heading and S9 headline.
- Victory only in S6.
- Centred S8 quote with no role label.
- S3.5's minister-based 51/49 split.

## Don't
- Design anything or tune visuals. Placeholders are a flat panel with the scene id and a `p` bar.
- Edit `index.html` (v2), `data/story/*`, `styles/tokens.css` or the storyboard frames.
- Add any dependency beyond animejs (D10: D3 comes in S5b/S7).
- Change `roach()`.

## Done when
- `npx serve . -l 5173` and http://localhost:5173/v3/ (clean URL; `serve` drops query strings on `.html` redirects) scroll through every placeholder.
- `?debug` logs a correct, monotonic `p` per scene, both down and up.
- `?p=SNN:x` lands on the right frame for every key frame in the targets files.
- The harness produces side-by-side shots for at least S4 (4 frames) and S3.5 (3 frames).
- `docs/build/scenes/` has every brief and targets file.
- STATUS.md is updated: the scene/controller/roach contracts go under "Contracts in force", plus the final budget table.
- A report with three lists: passed, caveated, untested.
- Vali has reviewed it.
